get.summary: List the team's НОИ Приложение 9/10/11 documents
get.description: Returns every leave that has a built НОИ document, with its type, period, employee and submission state (входящ номер once filed). The document XML is fetched per-item via the xml endpoint.

get.summary: Build the НОИ Приложение XML for one leave
get.description: Returns the BPril9/10/11 XML (base64) the native app submits to НОИ, built from the saved document exactly as the web export does.

404.description: Leave or document not found for this team

get.summary: The НОИ submission result of a leave as a printable PDF

404.description: Leave or document not found for this team

get.summary: List the team's NRA declaration submissions
get.description: Returns every NRA declaration submission for the authenticated team, newest first, with its files (including the base64 file content the native app needs to sign and submit).

post.summary: Record the outcome of an NRA submission made from the native app
post.description: Marks a submission as sent to NRA (входящ номер, signing certificate) and, when NRA answered immediately, stores its processing result so the web portal updates too.

404.description: Submission not found for this team

get.summary: Build the BISS signing payload for a draft declaration
get.description: Returns the BORICA BISS /sign payload for the draft's saved files so the native app can hand it to the local BISS bridge (USB КЕП). The previewed bytes are exactly what gets submitted.

404.description: Draft not found for this team

post.summary: Submit a BISS-signed draft declaration to NRA
post.description: Accepts the raw BISS signatures and signer certificate, assembles the detached PKCS#7, submits to NRA and records the входящ номер — identical to a web-portal submit, so the web app stays in sync.

404.description: Draft not found for this team

422.description: Validation, missing API key/contact, or NRA error

post.summary: Re-poll NRA for a single submission's processing result
post.description: Re-queries NRA for one submitted declaration using its stored signer certificate and updates its status/result. Returns the refreshed submission so the desktop app updates just that row.

503.description: NRA did not respond; the submission is unchanged

404.description: Submission not found for this team

422.description: Draft, no certificate, no API key, or NRA error

get.description: Bills and invoices sent to OCR, newest first, with their processing status. Pass `since` (ISO 8601) to fetch only what changed.

post.description: Accepts `file` (or `files[]`, up to 10) plus `document_type` (bill|invoice), queues each for OCR and returns the created records. Answers 403 when the team has no OCR entitlement and 402 when it is out of scans.

get.description: The extracted document with its line items. `type` is `bill` or `invoice`.
